symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the array, which is the number of coordinates it is indexed by.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis $\ell$, a power of two: the number of entries along that coordinate direction.
symbols.quote: Let $r_\ell$ be the length of axis $\ell$, a power of two, that is, the number of entries along that coordinate direction.

symbols.name: input array
symbols.meaning: The array being transformed, with entries indexed by tuples $(j_1,\dots,j_d)$.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ be the input array, with entries $A_{j_1\cdots j_d}$.

symbols.name: transformed array
symbols.meaning: The result of the transform, with entries indexed by tuples $(k_1,\dots,k_d)$.
symbols.quote: Let $B$ be the transformed array, with entries $B_{k_1\cdots k_d}$.

symbols.name: axis input index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry along axis $\ell$, ranging over $0,1,\dots,r_\ell-1$.
symbols.quote: Here $j_\ell$ is the index along axis $\ell$, ranging over $0,1,\dots,r_\ell-1$, and $k_\ell$ is the output index along that axis.

symbols.name: axis output index
symbols.meaning: The output index along axis $\ell$, ranging over $0,1,\dots,r_\ell-1$.
symbols.quote: Here $j_\ell$ is the index along axis $\ell$, ranging over $0,1,\dots,r_\ell-1$, and $k_\ell$ is the output index along that axis.

relations.quote: The whole transform is a tensor product of one [Discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) per axis, the one of length $r_\ell$ on axis $\ell$.
